title: fix(app-shell): an approver chip that stands for several slots says so in words

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27615

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a new key: the `approvalsInbox.approverSlots` count family, added to all ten published `@object-ui/i18n` packs. No existing value is edited.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:审批「等待以下审批人」里，一个人占多个审批席位时，人名旁原来只画一个光秃秃的 `×3`;现在写成「Dev Admin · holds 3 approver slots」(中文「兼任 3 个审批席位」)。业务记录的审批面板和审批请求页两处一致。
- **为什么改**:同一行旁边是「1 位可审批人」,两个数字都对，但并排看像是矛盾，读者分不清是一个人还是三个人要审批。按 triage 裁定：只改文案，两个计数都不动。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低，只改一个徽标里的文字，加一个新的语言包键(十个语言包);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` 的 chip 渲染;`approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` 的 `PendingApprovers`;`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` / `zh.ts` 的 `approverSlots` 一族。
- **两分钟验证**:showcase 里以种子管理员打开 `EXP-DEMO`(High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum)的审批请求页;预期「等待以下审批人」显示「Dev Admin · holds 3 approver slots」,旁边仍是「1 eligible approver」。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

When one person holds several of a pending step's approver slots, the "Waiting on" chip collapses those slots into one chip. It used to draw the number as a bare `×3`, beside the tally line's "1 eligible approver" (objectui#12781 counts distinct principals). Both numbers are right, but side by side they read as a contradiction.

- **The chip says what its number counts.** Where the chip drew `×N` (N above one), it now draws the pack's words: "Dev Admin · holds 3 approver slots". It is the same copy, read by literal key, on the business record's approvals panel (`RecordApprovalsPanel`) and on the approval request page (`ApprovalDecisionPanel`'s `PendingApprovers`).
- **Neither count changes.** `approverChips` still collapses the same slots into the same chip with the same `count`, and `eligibleApproverCount` still counts that person once. No widget, dialog or hook is added.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: one new count family, `approvalsInbox.approverSlots`, in all ten packs.** Each pack carries every plural category its language selects, the same set as `progressEligible` beside it (`en` / `de` one and other; `fr` / `es` / `pt` add many; `ru` one, few, many and other; `ar` all six; `zh` / `ja` / `ko` count-invariant), plus the count-invariant base row. Real wording in every pack, not English placeholders: `en` "holds 3 approver slots", `zh` "兼任 3 个审批席位", `ja` "承認枠 3 件を兼任", `ko` "승인 자리 3개 겸임", `de` "belegt 3 Genehmigerplätze", `fr` "occupe 3 sièges d'approbateur", `es` "ocupa 3 puestos de aprobador", `pt` "ocupa 3 postos de aprovador", `ru` "занимает 3 места согласующего", `ar` "يشغل 3 من مقاعد الاعتماد".
- `ApproverChip.count` gains a doc comment saying how it is drawn and why.

Changeset: `.changeset/27615-approver-slots-chip.md`, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, carrying the same `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines.

## Tests

- **Record approvals panel**, a new `describe` in `RecordApprovalsPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx` (same fixtures as the objectui#12781 pins: user-id slots, a name per id, the server's quorum tally):
  - the stock committee quorum (one user in all three slots): exactly one chip, whose text is `Dev Admin· ` plus the pack row `approverSlots` at count 3, no `×` anywhere in the panel, and the eligible line is the pack row `progressEligible` at count 1;
  - one user in two slots among two others: three chips, only the doubled one carries the slot words at count 2, and the eligible line reads 3.
- **Approval request page**, the same two cases in `ApprovalDecisionPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx`, plus a `zh` case: under a `zh` provider the chip draws the `zh` pack's row (asserted different from `en`'s) beside the `zh` eligible line.
- Labels are asserted as the pack rows the components read, rendered by the same i18next instance, never as restated English prose.
- Two existing assertions moved from the bare `×2` / `×3` to the family's count-invariant row, which is what a provider-less render draws: `RecordApprovalsPanel.test.tsx` (the per-group chip test) and `ApprovalDecisionPanel.test.tsx` (the objectui#12077 three-slot chip test).
- The existing objectui#12781 tests are unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Chip count above one from two different people.** `approverChips` keys a chip by label, detail and group, so two distinct addresses that resolve to an identical name with no group (two users who share a full name, say) also collapse into one chip with a count, and the eligible count says 2 beside it. That is a property of the chip's key and was there before this change. The chip's `title` already lists both raw ids. This change gives the number words; it does not change what the chip groups.
- **Provider-less hosts** draw the count-invariant base row ("holds 3 approver slot(s)"), the same way the existing `progressEligible` line does there. With an `I18nProvider` the plural slot is selected.
- **The only other "Waiting on" line**, the approval status beside `DeclaredActionsBar`, lists each name once and draws no count, so there is nothing to reconcile there. The `×{group.items.length}` in `InboxPopover` counts notifications in a group and is out of scope.
- No new widget, dialog or hook.
